operations.new_value: **v1.10 Skill Routing & Verify Gate**: fix two real framework bugs from a downstream consumer's v4.7 retro. (1) `lib/provider.js#resolveSkill` checks provider install but not per-skill `SKILL.md` existence — add per-skill stat + parens-sigil opt-in fuzzy matching (`(skill-name)`) with role-filtered token-overlap algorithm + 5-step resolution chain (sigil-fuzzy → exact → manual prompt inline → subagent-dispatch directive → bare prompt) + ONE consolidated workflow-start diagnostic. (2) `templates/workflows/milestone.yaml` review phase is prose-only — add new `cp run-verify` scaffold subcommand reading `behavior.test_command` (auto-detect chain: `npm test` → `pytest` → `cargo test` → `go test ./...`) with new `verify` phase inserted before `review` via `depends_on`, opt-out via `behavior.verify: false` / `--skip-verify`. Plus README PowerShell-on-Windows blurb (`cp` aliases to `Copy-Item`; use `cp.cmd`). 5 phases. Spec: `docs/superpowers/specs/2026-06-02-v1.10-skill-routing-verify-gate-design.md`. — v1.10

new_row.Rationale: Parens 100% YAML-safe at any position; sigil is a flag ("fuzzy allowed") not a glob pattern; in-place sigil scales naturally where whole-property `X_skill_fuzzy: true` doesn't
new_row.Outcome: v1.10 P1 — `lib/provider.js` parser + role-filtered token-overlap matcher

new_row.Decision: Verify gate is `kind: scaffold` (real CLI exec)
new_row.Rationale: LLM-in-the-loop review can be fake-attested past; only objective CLI execution provides a real verification boundary
new_row.Outcome: v1.10 P3/P4 — new `cp run-verify` + `verify` phase before `review`

new_row.Rationale: When SP ships an exact-match skill, deterministic canonical invocation > fuzzy; reserve fuzzy for genuine catalog gaps (e.g., no `code-review` skill exists in SP)
new_row.Outcome: v1.10 P5 docs + concrete `milestone.yaml`: `brainstorm_skill: brainstorming` strict, `review_skill: (code-review)` fuzzy
